case_status: original authored specification, not candidate output or owner-approved production story
instructions: Write original natural Bengali story prose from the supplied existing professional brief. Do not copy another drama or imitate a living writer.
Ask a central dramatic question requiring a costly protagonist decision. Father supports the job but fears solitude; daughter’s independence is not selfishness.
Give each major character want, need, fear, contradiction, relationship, internal conflict, observable behavior and emotional change.
Every beat changes information, relationships, emotion, stakes, goals or options through a credible cause. Track character knowledge and possessions.
Earn at least two subtle emotional moments through earlier setup, small human actions and consequences; tragedy or speeches are not automatic emotion.
Include one motivated humorous moment from personality, irony, awkwardness or relationship; avoid unrelated jokes.
Use fair clues and information control for one earned reveal; escalate choices and consequences rather than repeat scenes.
Use visible action, location or sound for filmability. Flag cultural and economic specifics as hypotheses unless supplied verified sources establish them.
Return only the artifact contract. Self-critique is a proposal, never an independent professional score. Preserve exact owner locks and untargeted records.

adversarial.authored_control: Lost payment reappears without a prior recovery event.
adversarial.expected: Identify the unsupported recovery and revise affected causal beats only.

adversarial.authored_control: Daughter reacts to a ticket before discovering it.
adversarial.expected: Require a previous disclosure or discovery event; preserve knowledge states.

adversarial.authored_control: Unprepared terminal illness is introduced solely to force tears.
adversarial.expected: Identify missing emotional investment; prefer established behavior and consequences.

adversarial.authored_control: An unrelated joke interrupts a serious choice.
adversarial.expected: Tie humor to personality, relationship or situation; remove unsupported interruption.

adversarial.authored_control: Father only obstructs and daughter only reacts.
adversarial.expected: Give both defensible wants, fears, contradictions and consequential choices.

adversarial.authored_control: Three scenes repeat fear of departure without changing any story state.
adversarial.expected: Combine or revise exact beats so information, relationships, stakes or options change.

adversarial.authored_control: Revision requests the father become a villain despite the approved lock.
adversarial.expected: Preserve the lock; escalate to owner rather than revise it.

budget.policy: Proposed ceiling only, not owner authorization. One canary; one primary story assembled from foundation, three acts and a final reflection/treatment; at most one targeted revision. Reflection follows actual supplied beats. Count failed calls. No automatic retries or model substitution. Verify each exact token budget with the approved cached tokenizer; stop on truncation or missing prior section.
